info.title: eMenu POS API
info.description: Profile-bound restaurant POS operations and business staff setup. See pos-api.md for credentials, amounts, operating dates, and retries.

post.summary: Sign in for profile discovery
post.description: Use the business slug and existing eMenu PBKDF2 password proof. For a staff username, include it together with the resolved email and proof. The discovery token lasts 15 minutes.

post.summary: Resolve a staff username for password proof derivation
post.description: Requires a profile token for an owner or manager. The staff member needs access to the active profile.

200.description: Account email for the existing password proof

get.summary: List staff eligible to sign in to the active profile

200.description: Staff and their current POS usernames

put.summary: Assign or remove a POS username
put.description: Requires a profile token for an owner or manager. The selected staff member needs profile access. Usernames are unique per business.

get.summary: List profiles available to the operator

post.summary: Start a profile-bound POS session
post.description: Requires a discovery token. The profile token lasts 12 hours.

delete.summary: Revoke the bearer token used for this request

post.summary: Enroll a device signing key
post.description: Use the profile token from a password sign-in. Repeat the same request with the enrolled public key to recover a lost response.

get.summary: List credentials for the selected profile
get.description: Owners and managers see the profile's credentials. Staff see their own credentials.

delete.summary: Revoke a device credential and its bearer tokens

post.summary: Renew a profile-bound POS session with a signed proof
post.description: Sign the credential ID, Unix timestamp, and a fresh nonce with the enrolled Ed25519 private key. The returned bearer lasts 12 hours.

get.summary: Read the branch's offline store assignment

post.summary: Assign an idle branch to the owner's enrolled device
post.description: The same device can repeat the claim to recover a lost response. An assigned branch accepts operating writes from its designated device through the store journal.

delete.summary: Release an idle branch after its journal is acknowledged

post.summary: Import one saved store operation
post.description: Use an operator's bearer on the designated device. The next sequence and the complete operation commit together. Repeat the exact body and idempotency key after an interrupted response. The body limit is 1,000,000 bytes.

post.summary: Approve a saved store operation after operator access is removed
post.description: Use an enrolled owner session from the designated register. Send the complete original envelope and its original idempotency key. The approving profile must be in the same branch.

get.summary: List approvals recorded for the selected branch
Read profile settings and current operating state
Read priced products and the configured catalog hierarchy
get.description: The page applies to products. The eligible hierarchy is included on each page.

get.summary: List branch tables and this profile’s open bills
List customers in the business directory
List working days for the profile’s branch

post.summary: Open a working day for the branch
post.description: Requires an owner or manager and a profile that uses working days.

get.summary: Get a branch working day

post.summary: Close the working day
post.description: Requires an owner or manager. Resolve linked shifts and open bills first.

get.summary: List cashier shifts for the selected profile

post.summary: Open a cashier shift for the profile

get.summary: Get a cashier shift and its recorded closing counts
List opening cash and cash movements

post.summary: Record a cash in or cash out movement

get.summary: Preview expected amounts or read final counts

post.summary: Declare counts and close the shift

get.summary: List sales in the profile

post.summary: Create a priced open bill

get.summary: Read a sale, line snapshots and payment entries

patch.summary: Edit an open bill at its current revision
patch.description: Supplying lines replaces the bill’s lines and refreshes the quote. Omit lines to keep the current quote.

post.summary: Complete a bill with all tenders and change
Cancel an open bill
Record a full reversal of a paid sale
post.description: Requires an owner or manager. The API records the reversal after external refunds have been handled.

get.summary: List profiles and queued settings

post.summary: Create a branch POS profile

get.summary: Read a profile and its queued settings

patch.summary: Update a profile or queue new settings
patch.description: A supplied config replaces the previous config. Settings are queued while the profile has a shift or open bill.

get.summary: List explicit profile grants

put.summary: Replace the profile’s explicit staff grants

get.summary: List business payment types

post.summary: Create a payment type

get.summary: Read a payment type

PosBearer.description: Opaque eMenu POS discovery or profile token as required by each operation.

AdminBearer.description: Existing eMenu Control owner or manager token.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this exact operation. Preserve it across retries and renewed POS sessions.

Error.description: Error response. See the integration guide for status and code handling.

profile_id.description: Profile that recorded the operation. When supplied, it must match the bearer session.

occurred_at.description: Original UTC time ending in Z

price_list_id.description: Empty for the base product price

issued_at.description: Unix seconds within 120 seconds of Worker time

allow_cash_float.description: Allows opening balances and cash movements for this payment type. Omitted values default to true for cash methods in a shift.

currency.description: Fixed payment currency. Older clients can omit this to use the POS profile's currencies.

allow_cash_float.description: Whether this payment type accepts opening balances and cash movements in a shift.

ProfileTableGroupIds.description: Active groups from the profile branch in display order. Null uses all active groups in branch order.

store_authority_required.description: The branch has a designated device for operating writes

price_list_id.description: The source price list, or an empty string for the base price
The source price list, or an empty string for the base price
